_help.about: [NOT WIRED YET — design §EW] Pocket worlds: Torchfire 1 is a set of bounded slices, one per biome, each with its ruins above and its dungeon below, joined underground and seen on each other's horizons. Not the planet (§CR is Torchfire 2). First guesses by Claude (chat), 6 Oct, except where marked Mike; the designer owns them.
_help.size: §EW.1. across_m: a world's size [min, max] (Claude's first guess, open for Mike). edge: the land itself closes a world (cliffs, water, thick forest, mountains); invisible_walls: never (§DM).
_help.clock: §EW.1, §EW.8 call 2. The 144-minute day runs in every world (sky/day_cycle.json). shared: one clock for all worlds (Claude's guess); day_length_from_latitude: each world's latitude (world latitude_deg) sets its day length and the sun's path (Claude's guess, open).
_help.life: §EW.1. plants: the biome's species by their real silhouettes (data/biomes, habitat.json; §CS: a forest is mostly one species). creatures: ambient sightings from the ecology's archetypes (data/creatures), going about their lives; population_sim: false (§ET.2, §EW.6).
_help.links: §EW.3 (Mike): worlds are loosely connected; you go underground in one and come out in another. by: underground. passage: what hides the load (Claude's first guess). loading_screen_ok: true (Mike): allowed where it can't be hidden. continuous_map: false: each world loads on its own.
_help.map: §EW.4 (Mike): an overworld map with fast travel to worlds already visited. from_to: hearth_to_hearth is Claude's first guess (leave one relit flame, borrow the next, §AW, §CQ), open for Mike.
_help.horizon: §EW.5. Near ground wholly this world's biome; farther out the land changes and fades lighter and bluer (R-rules). layers: near (this world's real ground), mid (impostors of this world's edge and the neighbours' landmarks, §ES.3), far (a painted band and the sky). far_landmarks: the other worlds' landmarks, so the peak you see is a place you can go (Mike); a world's neighbours sit in believable directions (§EW.8 call 6, Claude's guess).
_help.worlds: §EW.2. Mike's named worlds, then every biome gets one (every_biome). name; biome: a data/biomes id (Claude's first pick, open where marked); mike: what Mike said of it; theme: the crawler.json theme that belongs to it, if any; status: named (only named so far; each is talked through on its own before it is locked).

sea_caves.name: the underwater caves
sea_caves.mike: on the coast, seawater flowing through, or an underwater-caves temple; gutters and channels built into the architecture; PSO Caves 2, really teal

desert.name: the desert sandstone
desert.mike: a desert sandstone dungeon; read today's tomb as a desert dungeon

tundra.mike: a tundra snow and ice dungeon
